_about: The Paladin's Stage 0 cards in the card Structure of 2026-11-16 (book/cards/card-structure.md). THE BOOK reads these in the place of the cards of the same name in ../paladin.json; Foundry and the ruler still read ../paladin.json until the Foundry pass. Format: name, category and level (data, not printed), flavor, traits, escalation, frequency, cost (the bar's text: '2 AP', '1R', '1 or 2 AP', 'Passive'), distance, area, target, body (labeled lines in play order: {label, text}), blocks (a Version or a Mode: heading, traits only it has, its own distance / target, its body).

cards.name: Judge
cards.flavor: You pronounce a foe guilty before your god, and holy light dulls its blows against those who stand near you.

body.label: Judged
body.text: A creature stops being Judged when it goes Down. A creature Judged by you counts as Profane for you. The first time each round it damages an ally within 5 squares of you, that damage is reduced by your Power Modifier.

body.label: Special
body.text: You can use this only at the start of an encounter, or as a 0R when the creature you Judged goes Down.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target is Judged by you until the encounter ends.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target is Judged by you instead of the one you had.

cards.name: Smite
cards.flavor: Holy light gathers on your weapon as the fight wears on, and you bring all of it down in one blow.

body.label: Smite dice
body.text: [R] 1d6! Ho for each Escalation you have, up to 4 dice. Against a Profane creature they are 1d8!s.

body.label: Attack
body.text: Signature vs. Armor Defense

body.label: Tier 1
body.text: Your Smite dice.

body.label: Tier 2
body.text: [V] 1[W] + [Mod] + your Smite dice.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [V] 1[W] + [Mod] + your Smite dice + 1 more Smite die.

body.label: Special
body.text: When you use Smite, you can spend your Reaction AP to roll 1 more Smite die. Neither extra die counts toward the 4.

cards.name: Binding Light
cards.flavor: Your blow lands wreathed in light that roots your foe where it stands.

body.label: Attack
body.text: Weapon vs. Armor Defense

body.label: Tier 1
body.text: [R] 1d6 Ho.

body.label: Tier 2
body.text: [V] 1[W] + [Mod] + [R] 1d6 Ho; Immobilized (1 round).

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [V] 1[W] + [Mod] + [R] 1d8 Ho; Immobilized (1 round).

cards.name: Lay On Hands
cards.flavor: You stride to an ally's side and lay a hand on them, and a skin of pale light settles over them.

body.label: Setup
body.text: You Advance up to 5 squares in a straight line toward the target.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target gains Guard equal to 2 + your Power Modifier.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target gains Guard equal to 2 + your Power Modifier and can use 1 Rally Point.

cards.name: Shield of Faith
cards.flavor: You raise a hand, and a pane of light turns part of the blow aside and pulls your foe's eye to you.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: An enemy's [Strike] Action would damage the target.

body.label: Effect
body.text: That damage is reduced by 1 + your Power Modifier, and the triggering creature is Taunted by you (1 round).

cards.name: Rebuke
cards.flavor: You call out in your god's name, and your foe's stride falters and stops.

body.label: Trigger
body.text: The target moves away from you.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target is Hindered (EoT).

body.label: Save
body.text: Appeal

body.label: Tier 1 or 2
body.text: Its Move Action is disrupted.

cards.name: Lantern of Faith
cards.flavor: You call your god's light: around you, onto a foe, or into a foe's eyes.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You shed [[Bright|Bright light]] 3 until the encounter ends.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target sheds [[Bright|Bright light]] 1 (1 round).

body.label: Save
body.text: Instinct

body.label: Tier 1 or 2
body.text: [[Half-Blinded]] (EoT).

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.flavor: You plant yourself where the fight is worst: you crowd the ground at your feet, trade places with an ally, or carry one clear.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Squares adjacent to you are Difficult Terrain for enemies (1 round).

body.label: Effect
body.text: You and the target swap squares. Each of you is moved by a Reposition.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Reposition 2 the target.

cards.name: Commandment
cards.flavor: You speak with your god's authority: you call a foe to face you, steady the hearts around you, or order a foe to its knees.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target is Taunted by you (1 round).

body.label: Effect
body.text: You and allies within 3 squares of you ignore the Frightened condition (1 round).

body.label: Save
body.text: Appeal

body.label: Tier 1 or 2
body.text: Prone.

cards.name: Armor of Faith
cards.flavor: Each time you answer for an ally, your god's light settles on you like mail.

body.label: Passive
body.text: When you use a [Divine] Reaction, you gain Guard equal to 1 + your Power Modifier.

cards.name: Roving Judgment
cards.flavor: Your eye passes from one guilty foe to the next, and your god's attention follows it.

body.label: Passive
body.text: The 1 AP use of Judge costs you 0 AP.

cards.name: Kindled Wrath
cards.flavor: An ally's blood on the ground, and your god's anger is yours.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once an encounter, when an ally becomes Bloodied or goes Down, your Escalation increases by 1.

cards.name: Bulwark of Faith
cards.flavor: You step into the blow meant for them, and your god holds the line with you.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: An enemy's [Strike] Action would damage the target.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target gains Guard equal to what one of their Rally Points heals, before the damage. After the damage, they are Slid 1.

cards.name: Consecrated Ground
cards.flavor: You drive your weapon into the earth and the ground around it shines: your foes wade through it, and your allies stand firmer on it.

body.label: Effect
body.text: For 3 rounds, the Area is Difficult Terrain for enemies. Whenever you or an ally starts a turn in the Area, that creature gains Guard equal to your Power Modifier.

cards.name: Word of Radiance
cards.flavor: You speak a single word of your god, and light bursts from you: your foes burn in it and stagger back.

body.label: Save
body.text: Appeal

body.label: Tier 1
body.text: [R] 3d6 Ho; Pushed 3.

body.label: Tier 2
body.text: [R] 2d6 Ho; Pushed 2.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [R] 1d6 Ho; Pushed 1.

body.label: Special
body.text: Against a Profane creature, the damage dice are d8s.

cards.name: Weight of Judgment
cards.flavor: Your judgment hangs on your foe like a chain, and its steps drag.

body.label: Passive
body.text: A creature Judged by you has its Speed reduced by 2 (to a minimum of 1).

cards.name: Tireless Vigil
cards.flavor: The longer the fight lasts, the less escapes you: your guard is on two allies at once.

body.label: Passive
body.text: You gain 1 more Reaction AP when you regain AP. It pays only for [Divine] Reactions.

cards.name: Reckoning
cards.flavor: You stride among your foes, and your god's light breaks from you and throws them back.

body.label: Setup
body.text: You Advance.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Each target is Pushed 2.

body.label: Save
body.text: Appeal

body.label: Tier 1 or 2
body.text: Frightened of you (1 round).

cards.name: Hallowed Stance
cards.flavor: Your god's light carries you: wherever you are needed, you are already there.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once on your turn, a [Divine] Action you use gains "Setup: You Advance 3."
